units.source_text: 两个汉子将一块两三尺长的红布四个角拉得平平整整，铺在马道上，然后站在马道两旁。

en.t: Two men pulled the four corners of a piece of red cloth, two or three feet long, taut and smooth, spread it across the horse path, and then stood on either side of the path.

units.source_text: 马儿经过这里时，他们让马儿从红布下钻过去，

en.t: When the horse passed through there, they made it duck under the red cloth,

units.source_text: 姑娘则双膝用力，腾身跃过红布，然后落在从红布底下钻出来的马背上，

en.t: while the girl pressed hard with both knees, sprang up over the red cloth, and then landed on the back of the horse as it came out from underneath it,
